rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for formally or officially stating something.

example.english: The government will declare the pay-rise arrangements today.
example.traditional: 政府今日宣布加薪安排。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gam1 jat6 syun1 bou3 gaa1 san1 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this when declaring income or other information for tax purposes.

example.english: I still have to declare my taxes—what about you?
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 bou3 seoi3 nei5 ne1

rows.note: Use this specifically when declaring imported or exported goods to customs.

example.english: This shipment has arrived in Hong Kong, so we need to declare it to customs first.
example.traditional: 呢批貨到咗香港，要先報關。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 dou3 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 jiu3 sin1 bou3 gwaan1
